newsitem.title: POLAND: WESTA RECEIVER MAY TENDER PROCHNIK SHARES.
newsitem.headline: WESTA RECEIVER MAY TENDER PROCHNIK SHARES.

text.p: The receiver of failed Polish insurer Westa might open a tender for the 25-percent stake it holds in garment maker Prochnik SA if it cannot find a firm willing to manage it, the receiver said on Friday.
"If by the middle of next week an institution willing to manage the shares can't be found, we'll consider offering the shares in a tender," Dorota Brzezinska-Grabarczyk told Reuters.
She said she was currently conducting negotiations with financial institutions which might still be willing to manage the Prochnik shares.
Brzezinska-Grabarczyk said she had received offers from investors willing to buy the shares, including the Wielkopolksa Grupa Kapitalowa capital group.
Prochnik currently has 1.5 million shares outstanding, of which the Westa receiver is the largest shareholder.
Brzezinska-Grabarczyk had first said in September she was seeking a financial institution to manage the shares and later sell them.
